dynamic_line: "The Brand calls to beings beyond the ordinary world. Its pain can warn of a nearby presence, but it gives neither a name nor a direction. After dark, prepare cover and a way out. A bone and stone ward quiets its summons within eight tiles; it cannot banish creatures already there. This grove also offers a limited respite while it remains peaceful."

responses.text: Why does it hurt before I see anything?
What kind of shelter can quiet it?
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: The armor drives the body beyond pain and fear. That is its gift, and its danger. A wound you no longer feel remains a wound. The longer you rely on its rage, the harder it becomes to judge what your body can still bear.

responses.text: What price will I pay for Berserk mode?
Will you entrust the armor to me?
I brought my own armor. What should I know?
Is there any armor left here?
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: The frenzy can drive you for about two and a half minutes. Afterwards your strength and blood must recover; the price lasts much longer than the rush. The armor conceals pain, not the wound. Plan where to retreat before relying on it.

responses.text: Can I learn to stop before the armor takes over?
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: "An apostle has a body and a will of its own. A projection is an echo: destroying it does not kill the original. The God Hand preside over sacrifice and are not ordinary prey. Judge the creature before you, not merely a familiar name. A residence, servants and traces of victims can tell you more than a rumor."

responses.text: How did the two worlds collide?

dynamic_line: Some trophies keep a little of the power that shaped their former master. One may help you strike a demon, another see through darkness or endure heat. Ask about a relic you actually carry; none promises safety on every road.

responses.text: Can one of them free me from the Brand?
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: This house stands beside a spiritual tree. The crossing joined wounds in your world to paths in ours; the Eclipse deepened them. Quieting one wound helps those nearby, but cannot mend the whole boundary. That is why I guard this place and share what I can.

responses.text: Does that make the apostles projections?
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: The tree is the heart of this house. The books are kept above the western study, the guest rooms below it. The northern gallery leads to the kitchen; the southern one reaches the workshop and garden. You may rest, read, and sit beside the hearth. Leave the household in the care you found it.

responses.text: May I take some help for the next journey?
Will the Brand let me sleep here?
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: I have set aside food in the kitchen, repair materials in the workshop, and what you need for a small ward by the southern gallery. Those bundles are yours with my blessing. Take my travel notes as well; the rest of these shelves serves the household.

responses.text: Thank you. I will take only the prepared aid.
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: "The mark is a wound between worlds. It feels what your eyes cannot yet distinguish. Pain is a warning, not a promise that the thing has found you. Seek cover, listen, and keep a way out."

responses.text: Tell me more about that.

dynamic_line: "Begin by refusing battles you do not need. The armor will hide pain; it cannot replace the blood you lose. Watch your body when the rage passes, and keep supplies where your remaining hand can reach them. Strength without judgment only brings the next wound sooner."

responses.text: Tell me more about that.

dynamic_line: The charm is ready. Keep it while you finish preparing. Awaken it here when you choose to set out; until then you can rest or ask more questions.

dynamic_line: The living tree quiets the Brand while the grove is protected. Beyond it, a bone-and-stone ward can quiet new night summons within eight tiles. It will not drive away a creature already hunting you. A roof, water, a bed and a way out are still worth preparing.

responses.text: Why does the Brand hurt before I see anything?

dynamic_line: No relic can restore a life sacrificed or make the Brand disappear. Carry a trophy for the help it can give, and learn its limits. A little more strength, time or shelter from heat is no reason to stand where an apostle will strike.

responses.text: And the armor has a price too?
Ask something else.

dynamic_line: We can begin with the wound you carry or with the paths between these worlds. Ask what you need to understand first.

responses.text: What does the Brand feel?
Who crosses the wounds?
Why did the worlds collide?

dynamic_line: Godot and Rickert work at a woodland forge. They can help with a mechanical hand and a blade that must endure great strain. If you already own their work, ask for repairs rather than a second weapon.

responses.text: Mark the road to the forge.
Ask something else.
